settings.artistSplitRulesAddPlaceholder: Add a delimiter, e.g. feat. or /
settings.albumArtistModeDesc: How each album's displayed artist is chosen when scanning
settings.albumArtistFirstTrackDesc: Ignores the Album Artist tag entirely and always uses whichever track's artist was scanned first (current/default behavior).
settings.albumArtistTagDesc: Uses each file's Album Artist tag when present, falling back to the first track's artist otherwise.

settings.limiterDesc: Prevent clipping from Replay Gain and EQ boosts. Turning this off plays audio completely unprocessed, which can distort if Replay Gain or EQ push a track past full volume.
settings.musicFoldersDesc: Folders included when scanning your library
settings.multiArtistTaggingHint: Tracks with multiple artists (e.g. "Artist A & Artist B") are split automatically. In places with limited space, only the first-listed artist is shown - tag your files with the primary artist first for the best results.
settings.lyricsSubtitle: Manage automatic source priority and cached lyrics
settings.lyricsRenderModeDesc: Structure-aware line alignment based on surrounding lyrics. Turn off to use the legacy behavior: featured-artist lines always right-aligned, everything else always left-aligned.
